parsed.note_claim: William Barr was the current Attorney General when the report was filed in July 2019.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: President Donald J. Trump appointed Barr the 85th Attorney General of the United States on February 14, 2019. Barr served in that office until December 23, 2020.
parsed.reason: The page confirms Barr served as Attorney General from February 14, 2019 to December 23, 2020, which includes July 2019.
